title: RZ-1 A-wing (Star Wars, Return of the Jedi)
intro: The A-wing is a fictional Rebel interceptor from the Star Wars films, first seen in Return of the Jedi: small, very fast, with two laser cannons that can swivel. The pilot sits in a tight cockpit at the nose of a wedge-shaped hull, with a wide canopy and no droid socket.

areas.name: Canopy
areas.text: The wide canopy over the pilot.

panels.name: Canopy
panels.text: The clear roof over the pilot, with a wide view forward.
panels.context: A fast interceptor needs a good view to find and chase enemy fighters.

controls.name: Canopy
controls.text: The canopy gives the pilot a wide view, which a fast interceptor needs. Unlike the X-wing there is no droid socket behind.
controls.context: Without a droid the pilot handles navigation and problems alone.

areas.name: Instrument panel
areas.text: A compact panel under the wide canopy.

panels.name: Instrument panel
panels.text: A compact panel with small screens and lights in front of the pilot.
panels.context: The pilot looks at it briefly between looks outside.

controls.name: Forward screens
controls.text: Small displays in front of the pilot show targeting and sensor pictures.
controls.context: They help the pilot find enemy fighters and aim at them.

controls.name: Status lights
controls.text: Small warning and system lights on the A-wing's panel.
controls.context: The film does not explain each light; they show whether something is wrong.

panels.name: Side consoles
panels.text: Switches beside the seat and the mounts of the cannons.
panels.context: The film shows the switches but not what each one does.

controls.name: Switch banks
controls.text: Toggle switches on both sides of the A-wing pilot's seat.
controls.context: They belong to the fighter's systems; the film does not name them.

controls.name: Cannon mounts
controls.text: The two laser cannons at the wingtips can pivot to aim, as the Databank says. The control for this is not shown.
controls.context: Swivelling cannons let the A-wing hit targets that are not straight ahead.

areas.name: Flight controls
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Flight controls
panels.text: The hand controls in front of the pilot.
panels.context: The screen shows them only briefly.

controls.name: Flight controls
controls.text: The flight controls tip the nose up and down and roll the fighter left and right.
controls.context: The A-wing is very agile, so small movements change direction fast.

controls.name: Fire control
controls.text: A control on the flight grips fires the two laser cannons.
controls.context: The cannons sit at the wingtips and can swivel.

panels.name: Throttle
panels.text: This stands for the control that sets the craft's speed.
panels.context: Return of the Jedi does not show this control clearly; the catalog adds it so a joystick set has a place for the speed.

controls.name: Throttle (not clearly shown)
controls.text: This axis stands for the craft's speed: forward for faster, back for slower. The screen does not show where the real control sits, so its place is a guess.
controls.context: On a stick and throttle set this is the throttle lever; in the work itself the pilot is mostly seen with both hands on the flight controls.
